## Aim of the file

Run the whole pipeline in order, from the raw data to the analyses

## Load Libraries

```{r}
#| message: false

library("tidyverse")
library("here")
library("quarto")
```

## Pipeline steps

```{r}
pipeline_steps <- c("01_load",
                    "02_clean",
                    "03_augment",
                    "04_describe",
                    "05_analysis",
                    "06_PCA")
```

## Run the pipeline

```{r}
#| message: false

dir.create(here("data"),
           showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(here("results"),
           showWarnings = FALSE)

render_step <- function(step_name) {
  quarto_render(input = here("R", str_c(step_name, ".qmd")),
                quiet = TRUE)
  file.rename(from = here("R", str_c(step_name, ".html")),
              to = here("results", str_c(step_name, ".html")))
}

walk(pipeline_steps,
     render_step)
```

## Check the outputs

```{r}
list.files(here("results"))
```
